title: Table 1.2a Minimum tree provisions by lot size (apartments): reference

rows.value: 2 medium trees or 1 large tree and 1 small tree

notes: Reference transcription (values are text; the rules C1.2.4, C1.2.4-r1 and C1.2.4-r2 carry the counts as literals with exact boundary conditions).
